about_the_game:
Step into a mysterious village plagued by werewolves… but this time, it’s all happening online.

In Wolvenrise, players join a virtual room where everyone is secretly assigned a role:

• Villagers try to find and eliminate the werewolves.

• Werewolves secretly hunt the villagers at night.

• Special roles like Fool, Spy, and Doctor to spice up the strategy. (more roles will be released)

How it works:

• Each “night,” the werewolves secretly pick a victim.

• During the “day,” everyone debates, accuses, and votes to eliminate someone — hopefully a werewolf.

• The game continues until either the villagers wipe out the wolves or the wolves take over the village.

Features:

• Play with friends or strangers anywhere in the world.

• Built-in chat (sometimes even voice) to discuss and bluff.

• Automatic role assignment and turn management.

• Tons of roles, custom rules, and fun themes to choose from.

It’s the same thrilling, paranoid, hilarious experience of the classic card game — but without needing to pass out cards or argue over who’s “closing their eyes properly.”

short_description: The game takes place in a dark, medieval-inspired village shrouded in air of suspense and mistrust. The atmospheric setting immerses players in a high-stakes battle of survival, where every decision and accusation can mean the difference between victory and defeat.
